name: The Drone Witch
desc: You dwell in sustained tones, reverb, and the slow movement of frequency. Time is irrelevant. Only the endless present matters.
bonus: +2 to VCF, Reverb, and Chorus rolls

name: The Melodic Hunter
desc: You hunt with melody. Every note is intentional, every sequence a plan. You hear the song inside the noise and you will drag it into the light.
bonus: +2 to Pitch, Sequencer, and Turing rolls

name: The Rhythmic Beast
desc: You move to a beat that others cannot hear. Rhythm is law. The body knows before the mind does.
bonus: +2 to Tempo, Delay, and Formant rolls

name: The Scholar of Madness
desc: You have read too much. The books showed you how sound works at a level that the others cannot access. It cost you something, but what you gained is extraordinary.
bonus: +2 to LFO, Ladder, and Phaser rolls
